info.title: WayloAI API
info.description: Multi-tenant Voice AI platform. Dashboard users authenticate with a short-lived access token; customer backends use an API key.

field.description: Dotted path to the field that failed

error.example: must be a valid phone number

message.description: Human-readable summary. Never contains credential material.

alpha.description: Exponential history weight for Dynamic mode; higher adapts more slowly.

minSpeechDurationMs.description: Minimum speech duration in integer milliseconds.

minSilenceDurationMs.description: Minimum silence duration in integer milliseconds.

sound.description: The sound looped for the whole call. `default` plays office_quiet on phone calls and nothing on web calls. Unset is off; a new agent is created with `default` unless the request picks a sound.

volume.description: Background level relative to the agent voice, 0–1.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds after the call starts before the sound fades in.

enabled.description: Play typing while a reply takes longer than the delay.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds the agent thinks before typing starts.

volume.description: Typing level relative to the agent voice, 0–1.

silenceTimeoutMs.description: Silence, in integer milliseconds, before the agent checks in or, with no check-ins left, says goodbye and ends the call.

silenceRetryAttempts.description: Check-ins before the goodbye. 0 means no check-ins: the agent ends the call after the silence timeout.

url.description: HTTPS only. A {{name}} resolves to a context variable (session.id, workspace.id, agent.id, caller.number, now) or a declared parameter; any other name is rejected when the tool is saved.

headers.description: Static request headers. Values may carry {{name}}. A {{name}} resolves to a context variable (session.id, workspace.id, agent.id, caller.number, now) or a declared parameter; any other name is rejected when the tool is saved.

staticBody.description: Fixed body fields merged over the model arguments; a static key wins a collision. String values may carry {{name}}. A {{name}} resolves to a context variable (session.id, workspace.id, agent.id, caller.number, now) or a declared parameter; any other name is rejected when the tool is saved.

name.description: The function name the model calls. Letters, numbers, underscore and dash only; max 64.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the model-supplied arguments. Property names become the model arguments and are referenceable as {{name}} in the config url, headers and staticBody. A property cannot take the name of a context variable (session.id, workspace.id, agent.id, caller.number, now).

name.description: The function name the model calls. Letters, numbers, underscore and dash only; max 64.

closingMessages.description: Custom closing messages. Omit for the platform default.

name.description: The function name the model calls. Letters, numbers, underscore and dash only; max 64.

country.description: The country a number is read in when the caller gives no country code. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

confirm.description: Read the number back and ask the caller to confirm it.

instructions.default:
## Phone number

You need the caller's phone number once in this call. Ask for it in your reply right after their first request is handled. This question takes the place of asking what else they want, and it is allowed even when a tool result tells you not to ask a question. Do not call {{tool.name}} when you ask; call it only after the caller has answered with the digits, and pass exactly those digits. If it is refused, ask them to repeat it once, then move on. Say you have the number only after {{tool.name}} succeeds.
instructions.description: Added to the prompt of every agent that carries the tool. {{tool.name}} becomes the tool’s name. Empty adds nothing.

readBack.description: The sentence the agent speaks to read the number back. {{number}} is where the digits are said, and must appear exactly once.

name.description: The function name the model calls. Letters, numbers, underscore and dash only; max 64.

urlHost.description: The server host, derived from the URL. The full URL is never returned.

selectable.description: Whether this function can be added to an agent.

reason.description: Why it is not selectable, or null.

note.description: How the description the model reads differs from `description`, or null when it does not.

name.description: The function name the model calls. Letters, numbers, underscore and dash only; max 64.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the model-supplied arguments. Property names become the model arguments and are referenceable as {{name}} in the config url, headers and staticBody. A property cannot take the name of a context variable (session.id, workspace.id, agent.id, caller.number, now).

token.description: Short-lived access token. Kept in memory by web, never stored.
Short-lived access token. Kept in memory by web, never stored.

sendTestCalls.description: Also deliver for calls started from the dashboard, marked as tests.

instructions.description: Added to the prompt of every agent that uses the destination: what the agent tells the caller about the hand-off. Empty adds nothing.

confidence.description: Speech-to-text confidence score for this line (0.0 to 1.0), if available.

eventCount.description: Number of session events, for gating the admin-only events view.

urls.description: TURN URLs, UDP and TCP transports.

livekitUrl.description: The LiveKit server the browser connects to directly.

participantToken.description: One room, one identity, media grants only.

volume.description: Playback gain, 0–1, applied to the file as recorded.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds before the sound starts: after the call starts, or after thinking starts.

fadeInSeconds.description: Fade-in, in seconds, when the sound starts.

fadeOutSeconds.description: Fade-out, in seconds, when the sound stops. 0 for the background, which stops with the call.

backgroundAudio.description: The sound looped for the whole call, or null when off. Resolved per session channel: the worker never sees `default`.

thinkingSound.description: The sound played while the agent is thinking, after `delaySeconds`, or null when off.

eventCount.description: Number of session events, for gating the admin-only events view.

subject.description: The tool name for a tool event, the speaker role for a turn event.

occurredAt.description: When it happened, on the worker clock.

clientName.description: The name the client registered with.

verifiedHost.description: The host that served the client metadata document, so it controls that domain. Null for a dynamic registration, whose name and redirect are self-asserted.

redirectHost.description: Where the person is sent back to. Shown so a lookalike is visible.

organizationName.description: The organization the client would act in.

redirectTo.description: The client's redirect, carrying the code or the error. The browser navigates to it.
